title: flyBAMA
specs: Fly over iconic Flora-Bama restaurant spanning Florida and Alabama state line
Sunset tours offer views of beaches, Gulf waters, and coastal landmarks
Weight limit 300 lbs per seat, 550 lbs total group weight
Passengers weighed before flight; seating arranged by weight
Children 2 and older must have own seat and seatbelt; under 2 may sit on adult lap if combined weight under 300 lbs
At least two paying fares required per flight; single riders can pay for two seats with discount, join single rider list, or wait for suitable flight
Valid Military ID gets $5 or $10 off on select tours
Assistance available for most handicapped individuals; right to refuse if safety compromised
Strongly advised against intoxication; right to refuse intoxicated individuals

blurb: fly BAMA offers helicopter tours launching from OWA Parks & Resort, providing aerial views of Gulf Shores and Orange Beach. Tours include various scenic routes and a special sunset flight. Custom and festival tours are also available.
extraNote: Open weather permitting; no flying in rain, lightning, fog, or high winds · Sunset flight offered once per day at no extra cost with tours of 18 miles or more · Must return to departure point within 25-mile radius (Part 91 tour operator rule) · OWA Parks & Resort for regular tours; Shannon Elementary School for Shrimp & Petroleum Festival tours
